observations: Photo 0 shows a pink-paneled domestic sewing machine with a logo partly reading 'RICCAR' near the top right.
Photo 1 shows a different white domestic sewing machine with 'Semco indigo 6' branding, and background text reading 'SINGER' on another machine behind it.
Photo 2 shows a third, distinct white sewing machine labeled 'NOVAMATIC NM 868A'.

All three machines are compact, free-arm, household-style sewing machines on tabletop bases, not the heavy flatbed/industrial type with a separate motor and table stand typical of 'industrial' machines.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'MARTEX GLOBAL' appear on all photos, suggesting a reseller/catalog posting rather than a single owner's personal item.

claims.evidence: All three photos show small domestic/home-style sewing machines, not industrial flatbed machines with separate motor and table stand.

claims.claim: Used for sewing of clothes and multipurpose uses
claims.evidence: No video or stitching sample shown; functionality cannot be judged from static photos.

risks.risk: Three different machines (different brands/models) shown under one listing claiming to be one item.
risks.proof: A single photo set showing only the actual item being sold, with brand plate and seller's hand or ID card in frame for authenticity.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified/unverifiable single item, cannot assign one price

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or stitch correctly.
risks.proof: Short video clip of the machine running and sewing a test seam.

risks.risk: Possible missing accessories (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins).

risks.proof: Close-up photos of the base, motor, and underside.

proof_requests: Clarify which exact machine (brand/model) is actually for sale, with a photo of only that unit.
Video of the machine powered on and sewing a stitch line.

response.reason: The listing claims a single industrial sewing machine but shows three clearly different household-style machines (Riccar, Semco Indigo 6, Novamatic NM868A) with reseller watermarks, which is inconsistent with a genuine single-item sale and cannot be priced until the actual item is clarified.
